crossRefs.note: This is the history of the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that Yahweh…
This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him in God’s likeness.
This is the history of the generations of Noah: Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time. Noah…
The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, and replenish the earth.
Be fruitful and multiply. Increase abundantly in the earth, and multiply in it.”
These three were the sons of Noah, and from these the whole earth was populated.

people.name: Ham
people.line: One of Noah's three sons, father of Canaan.

people.name: Japheth
people.line: Son of Noah, ancestor of Indo-European peoples

people.name: Noah
people.line: Righteous man, built ark, survived flood

people.name: Shem
people.line: Noah's son, ancestor of Semitic peoples

translations.web: Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.
translations.bsb: This is the account of Noah’s sons Shem, Ham, and Japheth, who also had sons after the flood.
translations.kjv: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.
translations.asv: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, namely, of Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.
